_note: SPEC §8.11.7 FIELD EXERCISE (guarded).  ALGO00CAN static PPP, uncombined GPS L1/L2, state_ambiguity_basis = nl_wl so AR routes through applyMwWlConstraintsNlWl_ — the sibling path whose two guards had no field evidence.  Pairs ONE KNOB PAIR with _nlwl_unguarded (wl_only_ffr + wl_only_max_innov_cyc).  Truth is the ITRF2020 SSC monument, independent of the engine.
_why_uncombined: processing.uncombined_enabled = true is LOAD-BEARING. Standard IF-PPP AR is unbuilt and FAIL-UNSAFE: IF-combo ambiguity keys are not rejected in buildDdPairs, and getWavelength('L1C_L5Q') substring-matches 'L1', so LAMBDA would fix a non-integer with the wrong wavelength. The uncombined per-band path uses resolveWlConstrained verbatim and is the built, guarded route.
_why_dual: COD0MGXFIN OSB carries GPS PHASE biases on L1C/L1L/L1W/L1X/L2L/L2S/L2W/L2X for all 32 satellites, but NO GPS L5 phase bias. Triple-frequency AR is therefore not supported by this product; L1/L2 is the honest best case. Signal priority 'W' first lands on C1W/L1W + C2W/L2W, all four fully OSB-covered.
_why_bssd: The satellite phase bias comes from the product; the RECEIVER phase bias does not and is not separable undifferenced. between_satellite_sd removes it, so the SD ambiguity is the quantity that should be integer.
_truth: ITRF2020 IGS SSC @ 2024.3497: 918129.0619 -4346071.3363 4561977.9217 (sigma 0.7/0.8/0.8 mm). Grader is independent of the engine.
